thread:
Ravi: FYI — postmortem for today's cross-region traffic surge. Initial triage points to intermittent cert chain truncation combined with DNS TTL churn under high egress. Draft summary on Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/x/abc123

Ava: Thanks. Can we capture remediation owners + ETAs in this thread? I made a quick checklist below.

Jamison: Observed spike at ~09:42 UTC, retry rate ~3x normal. Traces show most retries from eu-west1 -> us-east1 flows.

Maria: Owners proposal: Jamison -> LB routing/header hotfix, Ravi -> cert rotation checks & automation, Ava -> DNS TTL rollback + monitor, Maria -> postmortem doc + alerts.

Ravi: Added action items to the incident board and kicked off a cert canary rollback for the most affected edge pool (will report status). Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/board/INC-2026-5539

incidents-bot: Action created: INC-2026-5539 "Cross-region TLS/DNS surge" assigned to Jamison, due 2026-03-24 23:00 UTC.

Jamison: I'll open a PR for more tolerant header parsing (suspect parsing bug when combined with large cookies). ETA EOD.

Ava: DNS emergency change rolling: increasing external TTL from 60 -> 300 for edge records. Command used:
```
gcloud dns record-sets transaction start --zone=redwood
gcloud dns record-sets transaction add --name=*.redwood-inference.com. --ttl=300 --type=A 1.2.3.4
gcloud dns record-sets transaction execute --zone=redwood
```
Change propagated to major providers; monitoring for latency now.

Maria: I'll add an alert: new metric "edge_retry_rate_after_5xx" and a pager if 5xx+retry ratio > 0.5% sustained for 5m. Putting the rule in ops-alerting.

Jamison: Quick debug note: TLS chain appears valid in ~90% of sampled connections; failures correlate with packet sizes >1400B. Suspect PMTU/fragmentation along the path when cert chain + large headers occur.

Ravi: Paging netops: @Elliot-netops can you validate PMTU/fragmentation and any path MTU blackholing between eu-west1 and us-east1 egress? Packet capture + mtr would be helpful.

Elliot-netops: On it. Will run mtr and tcpdump on the egress nodes serving the canary and post a short report by EOD with traces + suspected hops.

Ava: Scheduling a follow-up sync tomorrow 10:30 UTC. Agenda: owner updates, canary rollback status, alert thresholds, next steps. Calendar invite sent.

Maria: Added repro job to CI to simulate high-RPS with long headers:
```
wrk -t12 -c500 -d60s https://edge.redwood-inference.com/path?longheader=1
```
Using that to validate Jamison's patch.

Jamison: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/edge/pull/462 — adds header-parser hardening and reduces retry window. Requesting review (cc @Ravi).

Ravi: Owners & due dates (to keep the loop closed):
- Jamison: LB header fix + canary validation — due 2026-03-24 23:00 UTC
- Ava: DNS TTL change + monitor confirmation — due 2026-03-24 15:00 UTC
- Maria: Alerts + complete postmortem doc — due 2026-03-25 12:00 UTC
- Elliot-netops: PMTU/fragmentation verification report — due 2026-03-24 20:00 UTC

Ava: Ack. :white_check_mark:

incidents-bot: This follow-up thread will be archived to /incidents/2026/1758419973 for record-keeping.
